data.name: Lonestar Backyards & Buildings
data.address: 510 N Interstate 35 E Rd, Red Oak, TX 75154

reviews.text: Gaylan and his team did an excellent job building our detached garage/shop with attached patio space and was able to handle and implement a couple last-minute changes during the construction process without question.  His team were all easy to work with and friendly when confronted with questions about the process or issues that arose during construction.  All that combined with fair pricing, I won't hesitate to contact him again when we expand the patio!
reviews.author: Zach Daniels

reviews.text: Gaylan & Amy with Lonestar Backyards & Buildings walked us through the entire process and were AMAZING, they explained every step and were at our home almost daily during the building process to make sure we were happy with the progress and were willing and able to answer any questions we might have.  We could call them anytime day or night.  Our detached garage with patio was finished in Aug 2025 and we still hear from them letting us know that if we need anything adjusted or just touch up paint to just let them know and they will take care of it.  The job turned out better than we could have expected and they made us feel like family.  5 Stars is not enough, I will call them back for any future projects.  Call them today, you won't be sorry.
reviews.author: Michael

reviews.text: We couldn’t be happier with the patio that Gaylan Tucker with Lonestar Backyards & Buildings built for us! From the very beginning, Gaylan was great about keeping us informed and explaining each step of the process. His communication was clear and consistent, which made the entire experience stress free. The workmanship is top-notch, and the finished patio has become one of our favorite places to relax and spend time with family and friends. Gaylan is fair, honest, reliable, and truly cares about the quality of his work. We highly recommend Gaylan Tucker and Lonestar Backyards & Buildings to anyone looking for great craftsmanship and service.
reviews.author: Russell Williams

reviews.text:
1 year update: Hey Lonestar Team! Just wanted let you guys know, our family has had amazing memories made already and I've been really enjoying the separate space for my work. The Japanese style sliding doors you suggested for the office have created an amazing atmosphere and jaw dropper for our guests :D.

The team at Lonestar Backyards & Buildings did an amazing job with our guest house project! From initial consultation through each stage of the project and even after, we've been able to lean on the Lonestar team for anything we needed. I really appreciate the kindness, patience, and hard work of this team to work with us every step of the way and deliver on exactly what we wanted. There was no hesitation to make minor tweaks and adjustments when needed, their priority was making sure we were happy!!! The team went above and beyond to address all our requests and I would highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Aakash Patel

reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I couldn't be happier with the work done by Lonestar Backyards & Buildings! Gaylan and Amy are true professionals who transformed my front porch into a beautiful, screened-in addition that blends seamlessly with the rest of the house. Gaylan's innovative ideas were a game-changer, giving me options I never would have thought of on my own. Their attention to detail and craftsmanship is top-notch, and it feels like the porch was always a part of the house. I am beyond pleased with the results and can't wait to start our next project together! Highly recommend Lonestar Backyards & Buildings for any home improvement needs! Edit: before pics added!
reviews.author: Tom H.

reviews.text: Lonestar Backyards & Buildings did an absolutely fantastic job with my pergola!  A recent storm left it in shambles and they came to the rescue. They came and looked at it and within a few days it was completely redone!  So happy with their work, professionalism and friendliness!  I would highly recommend them.  I’d give them 10 stars if I could!  Thanks for a great experience and results!!!
reviews.author: Adrian Conder

reviews.text: We were fortunate enough to use LONESTAR Backyards & Buildings and we highly recommend them for all your future projects. We were unsure on what to get and Gaylin sat down with us and explained every option in detail. We started in one direction and he made sure we were satisfied every step of the way. He made sure my Husband got the tv just the way he wanted it and that I received enough outlets for our hot tub and future toys😊 They were professional, extremely patient and reasonably priced. I look forward to our next extension coming soon!
reviews.author: Kim Jones

reviews.text: Gaylan, John & team at Lonestar Backyards did a great job on our patio extension. My big concern was blending the old roof with new so it didn't look like an add-on - Mission Accomplished! Their price was fair and payment method was professional.  Highly recommend them for your project.
reviews.author: Tony Tarpley

reviews.text: Gaylan and his team added the Odyssey to our yard, enhanced our flagstone deck, installed a rooftop and added lighting to our pergola.  We are extremely pleased with his Team's work and look forward to enjoying our patio this summer!
reviews.author: Kevin Hunt

reviews.text: Gaylan, Amy and the Lonestar Backyards & Buildings team took our list of ideas and turned it into the most amazing garage, storage, gym and bathroom space in our backyard.  Gaylan’s experience combined with Amy’s attention to detail made them the perfect choice for our backyard project.  They were so wonderful to work with and I would recommend them to anyone looking to add a building, garage or porch addition at their house!
reviews.author: Kylie Lindsey

reviews.text: Gaylan and his team did a great job on our building. If you need a great addition to your backyard (garage, pool house, gazebo, building), I highly recommend! Trustworthy, on-time, dependable, and overall great work by their team.
reviews.author: Corby Kenter

reviews.text: Lone star built us a pavilion and a detached 2-car garage.  We are very happy with both.  The garage has the same appearance as the house, so it looks like they were built at the same time. The pavilion looks great, and our friends and family are impressed with it. I would call Lonestar again if I had another back yard project.
reviews.author: Kathleen Kedigh

reviews.text: Gaylan and his team recently built a 16x24 barn for us. Our old barn was crushed by an oak tree during a storm in May and we wanted it replaced with an identical barn. I sent Gaylan pictures and his team went to work. We couldn't be happier, as it turned as exactly as we wanted. They built on-site (very hard to find someone who will do this anymore) and were able to include a lean-to down one side of the barn for me to park my tractor and UTV under.  Lonestar Backyards and Buildings did the project on time, at a fair price and built us a quality barn. There was one minor oversight, and Gaylan had someone come out and address it almost immediately. We're already talking with him about building a small pavilion on our property. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Daniel Donohoe

reviews.text:
Lonestar Backyard is a great company and very easy to work with.

We love our backyard now even more with the beautiful Pavilion and Pergola. They done a Awesome job and followed up the whole time of the process.

This was great  investment added to our home.

Cedar hill TX
reviews.author: Billie Callahan

reviews.text: Gaylan from Lonestar planned and built this amazing detached garage for us. They made the process fast and easy and we are so happy with the final structure. Gaylan went the extra mile and made sure that the styling matched our historic home even down to matching the teardrop siding! We highly recommend Lonestar Backyards & Buildings.
reviews.author: Martin Holland

reviews.text: Lonestar backyards has done three projects for me in the last 10 years, this garage is spectacular!!!!!! Everything was explained to me along the way, and Gaylan was always just a phone call away to answer any question I had!! He absolutely did everything he said he would!! I Love My Garage!! Thank you Lonestar
reviews.author: James Moore

reviews.text: Lonestar did an amazing job with our backyard shed! The planning was detailed, the workers were professional, the timeline was quick, and the work was impeccable! Thank you Gaylan!
reviews.author: Brian Treadaway

reviews.text: Gaylan and his team did a fantastic job for us. We moved to Waxahachie in early 2019 and needed a new pavilion and shed. Very honest and reliable folks! We highly recommend Lonestar Backyards & Buildings.
reviews.author: Becky Heaton

reviews.text: Working with Gaylan has been a pleasure.  We purchased a swingset for our grandkids and he made sure it was ready for Christmas and helped make it special for us.  I feel this is just the being of our relationship and can't wait to provide him with bigger home projects.  Thank you for helping me!!!
reviews.author: Kathlene Lyons

reviews.text: I moved to Waxahachie in May. What a delight to find one stop shopping at Lonestar Backyards. First I needed a playset for the grandkids. Then I needed shed for storage. And I needed a pergola with an extension on the patio. Lonestar took care of all of these things for me. Truly quality work I am so pleased!
reviews.author: CJ Finney

reviews.text: Lone star backyard did a superb job and we are very pleased. They were right on schedule and everything looks fantastic. Pergola and the cement work is point on. We live in Mill Valley Mansfield. Five stars to Gaylan and the crew.
reviews.author: David Key

reviews.text: We had a large shop/garage built by Lonestar Buildings and Backyards this fall and it turned out great. We were promised the garage would look like it was built with the original house and they did a great job of making that happen. If you’re looking for a quality structure give Gaylen a call at Lonestar Backyards and Garages.
reviews.author: Gregg Nelson

reviews.text:
I have 40+ years as a Quality Engineer. I asked for a drive thru (doors at each end), 24x50,... finished garage built using the same roof style and building materials as my house.

“Lonestar Backyards & Buildings” delivered at a good cost per square foot! - EVERYTHING is high quality…. E.g. Attic Ladder, roof trusses, workmanship, etc. IT LOOKS GREAT! -

Note* Quite a few folks have stopped and taken a walkthrough. All agreed it is a job well done.
Note*  As a result, I intend to build more house matching additions!
reviews.author: Barrett Blake

reviews.text: We got a detached garage and extended our patio from Lonestar. Reasonable prices, great workmanship, and Gaylan was a pleasure to work with!
reviews.author: Tj Hanes

reviews.text: Gaylan has built 2 carports for us and a beautiful pavilion in the Ovilla area. All were completed promptly and blend in with the architecture of our house. His workmen were courteous and friendly as well as experienced. We are completely satisfied with his work.
reviews.author: Don Austin

reviews.text: Lonestar Backyards & Buildings has done a great job for both our projects to our new home! We had a pergola built first and we were very pleased with the craftsmanship, the quality of work and the speed of service.  We then later asked Gaylan to have a storage built for our backyard and were not disappointed with the results!  The storage unit was built with quality materials and looks great! Again the gentlemen who built it were professional and finished in a timely manner!  We are definitely recommending Lonestar Backyards & Buildings to others that need or want additions to their yards or home.  Thanks again Gaylan!
reviews.author: Tina M.

reviews.text: I'm very proud of my new 16'x 20' storage building from Lonestar Backyards & Buildings.  It's well-constructed and spacious.  It was built in just one day with no fuss or inconvenience to me.  I heartily recommend Lonestar Backyards & Buildings!   Tom in Duncanville, TX.
reviews.author: Tom Greco

reviews.text: Gaylan and his team did a great job.  I’m an engineer.  He built it to my specs and corrected issues as they came up!
reviews.author: Pete Falletta

reviews.text: We live in the Brian Terrance, Red Oak area  where Long Star built our Pergola this past summer. We must say we are still in love with it! Mr. Gaylan and his crew arrived on time ready to build our Backyard Paradise. The quality of wood they used is great and sturdy.  They did an OUTSTANDING JOB and we highly recommend their services. Here are a few Pics for your review. Again you will not be disappointed! Great quality, beautiful Pergola!
reviews.author: Pamela Everett Taylor

reviews.text: Gaylan and his team built us a new garage with shop attached, and a separate pergola near our pool.  The experience was positive from beginning to end.  Gaylan is a great communicator, watches over his projects, and provides an excellent product!  We are very pleased how everything turned out.  We highly recommend Gaylan, you won't be disappointed!  Thanks again Gaylan!
reviews.author: bev webb

reviews.text:
Gaylan and his team are top tier.  There have been various stages to my project - at each phase Gaylan sets expectations when the team will arrive. What has been great is he stops by while they are working and after they leave to make sure the work has been completed as expected. If there have been any questions post project Gaylan is only a phone call away.

My garage came out great! I'm looking forward to my next project with you all!
reviews.author: LaShonda S

reviews.text: Compliments to John & his crew for doing a great job, being here on time and cleaning up after themselves. Also they were fast, completed my 10x20 barn shed in less than 7 hrs and did a quality job for the best price around. If I need any other outdoor project done I will definitely be contacting them. I recommend you do too!
reviews.author: Quinton Brown

reviews.text: Lonestar Backyards and Buildings did a great job on my 20X26 stone and brick detached 2 car garage. Galyn Tucker supervised every step of the way and made sure I was happy with each phase. The quality of the work has been excellent and I am super excited to have my project completed. Thank you Galyn, I am one happy customer among many. Thank you John Smith for your referral.
reviews.author: elizabeth ortiz

reviews.text: I highly recommend this business for your garage, pergola, or other backyard structure needs.  They are beautiful and very well built.  The owner, Gaylan and his staff are so pleasant and professional and very attentive to individual customer wants and needs!!  Thank you Gaylan for all that you do!!!!
reviews.author: Loretta Phillips

reviews.text: Gaylan and his team did an outstanding job on our detached garage here in Bob White Estates on Black Champ Rd!  Designed and built exactly how we wanted with the look of our home!  Very professional throughout the process and always kept us in the know!  Highly recommend his services!
reviews.author: JB Kemp

reviews.text:
Lone Star built two structures for us here in the Garden Valley Homes addition in Waxahachie. A storage shed and a patio pavilion. Both structures( on separate dates) were completed from start to finish, in one day. Work sites were cleaned, no trash left behind.
No deposit was required in advance before construction was started. Very satisfied with the quality of workmanship. Very professional. We will call Lone Star to build a fire place addition to our pavilion in the future.
reviews.author: gretchen horn

reviews.text: Lonestar has built a garage and a pergola for us. Both experiences was easy and very smooth. Gaylan communicates from beginning to the end and is always available for questions. Great people to work with.
reviews.author: Vic Tumlinson

reviews.text:
I never write bad reviews but I feel this is my only recourse. We spent a lot of money on a swing set from here so I expected it to last a long time. We purchased it about 3 1/2 years ago & have re-stained it every year to protect it but the main supporting beam has a crack right down the middle. We called over 2 months ago to make them aware to follow up on their "warranty". They kept saying someone would come look at it and it took weeks to get someone to look at it. We have continued to call to see if the warranty is going to pay but keep getting the brush off. My husband and I have called numerous times recently and nobody will call us back. We've been dealing with this January.
Update- Once I posted this review, the owner contacted me and they replaced the actual beam, however, they charged us for the labor and the beam wasn’t the same stain color so we had to pay someone to re-stain it.
reviews.author: Alison Fourtner

reviews.text: I have had several sheds and a patio completed by Lone Star Backyards and Buildings.  One shed I had done almost 30 years ago is still as good as new.  My most recent project by them was a 10' x 30' covered patio.  They always do a great job, and do it quickly, all the while cleaning up after themselves.
reviews.author: Sheryl Hurd

reviews.text: Gaylon and his team did an outstanding job constructing my detached garage in Legacy Estates to match our home.   We needed additional space to park a vehicle, store our lawn equipment and a home gym.  This was the perfect solution.
reviews.author: Randall Weatherspoon

reviews.text: I had a barn built in the Red Oak area.   I had a great experience.  It was done quickly and with high quality.  The owner Gaylon made the process so easy. I would recommend them for your backyard storage needs!
reviews.author: Jacqueline Vessel

reviews.text: If repeat business means anything, then our experience means a lot! Three sheds, two pergolas, large carport, two-car garage and more recently, screened in porch. Lone Star does quality work at a fair price. Once they start a job, they finish before going on to something else. Always our first call for a project.
reviews.author: Ann Spencer

reviews.text: Got A gazebo installed by Lonestar Backyards in just 2 days!!!! Very professional contractor. I definitely recommend!!! I will call them again on my next project!!!
reviews.author: Juan Garza

reviews.text: This company did outstanding and amazing work for us. We bought a storage building they had material delivered then came put up building in timely manner.  The guys that put building were very nice and they cleaned up after they were done.  Will definitely recommend them to family and friends.
reviews.author: Betty Griggers

reviews.text: We had a pretty good experience with Lonestar; very good workmanship, decent price, and easy to work with. Could have used a little more communications regarding scheduling. But, overall, a good experience and we’re real happy with the finished product.
reviews.author: Michael Harvey

reviews.text: Lonestar Backyards a terrific job on a garage and backyard patio addition for our new home. Gaylon and his crew were quick and efficient. I highly recommend!
reviews.author: Tammy Coppock

reviews.text: Got a 14x20 build built by lone star backyards and buildings and they are professional and no Hassel. Builders had it done in one day and excellent craftsmanship. Have and always will refer more customers to them.
reviews.author: matt hancock

reviews.text: Gaylon and company did exactly what he said he would.  Clean up above and beyond expectations.  12x16 building was perfect.  Would recommend to everyone that is looking for a quality building at a great price.
reviews.author: Becky O'neal

reviews.text: Gaylan's crew built us a 24x16 shop and 20x16 pavilion on 2018. We now spend all our time outside with our family and neighbors (before COVID).
reviews.author: Leslie Tackitt

reviews.text: Great company. I love my shop. They did an absolute stunning job that was top notch and a step above the rest of the shops i have seen.
reviews.author: Jonathan Higgins

reviews.text: This company did an outstanding job building our garage. Based on our build and the great communication I would highly recommend using this company.
reviews.author: Dave Devine

reviews.text: Great service and excellent work. Did a great job with our garage and extended backyard deck
reviews.author: Antoine Hughes

reviews.text: Great company with quality craftsmanship
reviews.author: Jody hancock

reviews.text: Great people. Love the work.
reviews.author: Shelley Martinez

A single older complaint about warranty service exists but is not a recurring pattern in recent reviews. The business seems established and well-regarded for custom outdoor projects.
fake_signals: Some reviews mention same owners (Gaylan/Amy) in similar positive phrasing
